path: greedy walk from the current object to the unique nearest unvisited teal 2x2 object visible in the same two-row or two-column band; visibility requires the gap between objects to be background, and the walk stops when no such teal object exists
trajectory: paint the 2-pixel-wide background gap between consecutive objects orange
transform: preserve all red and teal objects; leave teal objects not reached by the walk unchanged
multi_step: after each connection, the reached teal object becomes the current object; already visited objects are not chosen again
